hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 ETH⟷phiEth swap curve by intercepting swaps in beforeSwap, taking input from the PoolManager, minting or redeeming phiEth via deposit/withdraw, and returning a full BeforeSwapDelta to bypass concentrated liquidity. Blocks direct liquidity additions and restricts pool initialization to ETH/phiEth pairs with zero fee.
